source_message.text: One idea I had was an instant quote calculator. It would let clients complete a form or quiz with questions about the services they want, then calculate an estimated price in real time. I looked into this, and it appears somewhat complicated. Is [PERSON_NAME_004] something you would be able to do?

value_updates.input_behavior: ask clients which services they wish to receive

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
[PERSON_NAME_003] you very much for the explanation. For the calculator, all our services are itemized, and the more services someone selects, the more bundling options we can provide. Therefore, the calculator must identify whether the chosen services qualify for a bundle; otherwise, it would simply total the individual services. I imagine a survey-style format, potentially as follows:

What is the property's square footage (under 1000 is pricing tier 1, 1001 - 2000 is pricing tier 2, 2001 - 3000 is pricing tier 3, 2001 - 3000 is pricing tier 4, and 3001 + is pricing tier 5; *answering 1253 sqft* places it in pricing tier 2)
Photos (yes/no) Yes = +200 No = +0 (*answers yes))*
*Videos? (yes/no)* Yes = +200 No = +0 (*answers yes))*
Enter the address (the distance from the home office is calculated) (if it is over 25 miles, apply a $50 dollar surcharge) (*Answers address and is 28 miles away))) +50*
*(qualifies for basic bundle) -$100*
*(presses submit)*
*Shows total: $350*

value_updates.pricing_logic: apply a qualifying bundle when selected services meet bundle rules; otherwise add individual service prices
